Avery / team — attaching a redline. Key legal positions we should ask ProspectCo to accept:

1) Publicity permission limited to: case studies, press releases, and sales collateral (digital or print) upon 30 days' prior written notice; not an automatic global right.
2) Logo usage: require a separate written approval for homepage or product page placement; we can allow inclusion in a downloadable case study and in a press release with approval.
3) Quotes: Redwood may use anonymized short excerpts without attribution (<= 40 words) for product metrics. Any quote attributed to ProspectCo requires prior written approval and a chance to review edits.
4) No customer logos in paid advertising or sponsorship without express written consent.
5) Add a mutual non-confidentiality carveout for high-level metrics that are aggregated and not PII or sensitive.

I do not recommend allowing unconditional logo placement. If marketing wants broader rights, we can request a narrow, timeboxed license (e.g., 12 months) and add an on-demand removal clause.

I attached Redlines_ProspectCo_OrderForm_20250603.docx (inline comments on Sections 6-8). If we stick to the 30-day notice and the attribution rule, this should be acceptable to most enterprise buyers.

Monica Patel
